name: Garage Angels
decision_note: Brno-based club of angel investors (founded 2019 by ex-AVG people) that co-invests in early-stage startups (HTG Medical July 2026, Flae Robotics October 2026); an angel network, not a VC fund.

evidence.quote: Stojaté vody chce nyní více rozdmýchat nově zformované uskupení nesoucí název Garage Angels.
Do financování se zapojily fondy Garage Angels, Electron Capital Partners a JIC Ventures i stávající investoři Jinej fond a Dendis Capital.
Investovaly do něj fondy Purple Ventures a Garage Angels.

analyst_notes: Quick exclusion dossier (angel network, S1). Lupa (2019) describes Garage Angels as a newly formed group of angel investors; ARES shows an association (z.s., 2024) and a management company (s.r.o., 2024) in Brno, which may indicate a pooled vehicle, but no fund was identified, so it is treated as an angel network. Media sometimes call it a 'fund' (e2, e3). Activity is current: HTG Medical second pre-seed tranche (EUR 450k, round shared with JIC Ventures and others, 2026-07-14) and Flae Robotics (with Purple Ventures, 2026-10-08). If a Garage Angels fund vehicle is confirmed, re-screen as vc. No website could be fetched (garageangels.cz redirect loop).
